- Use **R3** to cycle Discover between **All**, **Movies** and **Shows**.
- Add a visible R3 key beside the filter, with feedback when pressed. L3 no
  longer changes the media filter; D-pad selection still works.
- Recover update-storage access through ELF Loader when a folder launch cannot
  prepare its download directory. Recovery runs when choosing **Download update**,
  after the interface and account have loaded.
- Report missing storage, permission errors and full storage separately.

If an installed 1.10 or 1.11 build still reports an update-folder error, install
the complete **1.12 folder ZIP** once. Keep `/data/slopfin/config.json` to preserve
your sign-in and preferences. The new helper is part of 1.12 and cannot repair an
older running updater before that version is installed.

R3 cycling, focus retention and installer guards pass host checks. The storage
helper restored access on the development PS5 running firmware 8.20. A complete
1.12 in-app download/install/restart still needs console validation.
